Chinese Pinyin Sound Guide

Tap any sound to hear it 3 times. See how to shape your mouth, what it sounds like in real life, English look-alikes, and real Chinese example words you can also tap to hear.

Speed 0.8x
Initials are the consonant sounds that begin a syllable. There are 21 of them. Tap the big colored button to hear the sound; tap a word chip to hear a real example. Listen for what the example words share.
Finals are the vowel (and vowel+nasal) endings — 24 of them. Important: some finals cannot be said on their own, or change sound when alone. Those are marked Needs an initial and the button plays a real example word instead.
Real human recordings — female & male — embedded directly in this file, so it works offline with no internet needed.
Audio sources: female by pffy, male from lost-theory.org · Each sound plays 3 times · 加油 — keep going!
